This section records teaching-assistant appointments and course-related materials that are appropriate for public distribution.

## Publication policy

Only materials that may be shared publicly will be posted here. Course handouts, textbook exercises, student information, grading records, and internal announcements are excluded unless public distribution is clearly permitted.
